notes: Transactions: a row in an investment account can now be counted in the budget by itself (off budget - count it / in budget). Its spending shows on the Budget page and reports, and in the money flow as its own band from the investment side to the category, never through Income. Money flow: From savings is now From bank balances (red, set apart from the pay), the Saved tile says where a shortfall came from, and Settings > Income sources lets you give each source a plain name for the chart.
